metadata.description: Your AI job-search assistant: country-ready CVs, tailored applications you approve, and follow-ups at the right time.

home.description: Your AI job-search assistant: country-ready CVs, tailored applications you approve, and follow-ups at the right time.

blocks.3: Jubilee doesn't collect your CV or your job applications yet, because those features aren't built. Before they are, this page will say what they collect.

blocks.2: When AI features arrive (tailoring your CV, writing letters), this section will say which provider is used and what it sees, before those features touch your data. AI will never add experience you don't have, and nothing will be sent to an employer without your approval.

list.0: Your CV and everything you put in Jubilee stay yours.

blocks.1: Jubilee is being built to help you write your CV, tailor it to jobs and keep track of your applications. Before a new feature arrives, these terms will be updated to cover it.

blocks.0: What you put into Jubilee, such as your CV, stays yours.

list.0: put false information about yourself or anyone else in a CV or an application
